g.text: Padded grid: one CTA per possible flat row (T x topk = 16 CTAs)
Every CTA scans masked_m. CTA b then looks for flat row b. Only CTAs 0-5 find a row.
How the CTAs run on a toy GPU with 4 CTA slots (2 SMs x 2 CTAs each)
gray = scan only (1 unit), color = scan + one row (1 + 3 units). The scheduler starts the next CTA
in a slot as soon as the slot is free. Empty CTAs still take a slot, a launch and a scan.
In the toy, 10 empty CTAs hide behind 6 real ones. In the real case, empty CTAs outnumber
the slots about 20 to 1, so every slot runs about 20 empty CTAs back to back.
DSV4-Flash, 4 x B200, b = 64 per GPU
CTA slots on the GPU (SMs x CTAs per SM)
